pages.text: $(italic)The pinnacle of arcane power, fragile as glass and twice as sharp. Weak early, devastating late.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -20%  |  Equipment HP: $(bold)Halved$() (glass cannon)$(br)Mana Pool: $(item)2.5x base$() (250 from default 100)$(br)$(bold)Armor Penalty:$() -28.6% armor, -20% toughness (final value); a full-robe Archmage nets ~50% armor

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Arcane Supremacy$(): $(item)+50% magic damage$(), the highest in the game. It covers every Iron's Spells school and vanilla magic, but not Ars Nouveau's spells.$(br2)$(bold)Frail Melee$(): $(warn)-50% attack damage$().$(br2)$(bold)Mana Attunement$(): a Spell Power bonus that grows with your tier:$(br)  T1: +0% | T2: +5% | T3: +10% | T4: $(item)+15%$()

pages.title: Passives (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Expanded Pool$(): a mana pool of $(item)2.5x base$(), the largest (the Elemental, Blessed and Corrupted have 2x, the Battlemage and the Void Summoner 1.9x).$(br2)$(bold)Glass Frame$(): the armor penalty scales with your final value, so it never zeroes a robe build. Your equipment HP is halved.$(br2)$(bold)Class stats$(): every magic hit you land deals +25% more, and your mana refills faster.

pages.title: Glass Nuke
pages.text: A $(thing)Faefolk Archmage$() at T4 in full robes:$(br)  magic damage +80% (Supremacy 50, Faefolk 30) times spell power +15% (Mana Attunement T4) = $(item)x2.07$() on every Iron's spell, or x2.59 with the Archmage's +25% on a magic hit.$(br)  The cost: -35% HP, halved gear HP and ~half armor (full robes).$(br2)One hit kills you. One spell kills everything else.

pages.title: Glass Nuke, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Faefolk$(): the purest glass nuke (the x2.07 build).$(br)$(thing)Elf$(): +5% magic damage and speed. A safer kit.$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$(): 40% more health (22.4 instead of 16), all of it kept since only gear health is halved, which offsets the fragility.
